summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.addEntry per RQ-FXL-0001 (validation in DF-FXL-0001 order: amount, description, date, duplicate id), the RQ-FXL-0101 control-character rule, and RQ-FXL-0002 (stored trimmed, Approved=false, ApprovedBy=None, appended last). Edited fx-ledger/src/FxLedger/Ledger.fs and fx-ledger/tests/FxLedger.Tests/LedgerTests.fs.

criteria.criterion: Amount 1,000,000 is accepted; 1,000,000.01 and 0 are rejected with InvalidAmount
criteria.test: addEntry accepts amount 1000000 and rejects 1000000.01 and 0

criteria.criterion: A description of 200 characters after trimming is accepted; 201 is rejected with InvalidDescription
criteria.test: addEntry accepts a 200 character description and rejects 201

criteria.criterion: Descriptions containing control characters such as tab or line feed are rejected with InvalidDescription (RQ-FXL-0101)
criteria.test: addEntry rejects control characters in the description

criteria.criterion: An entry dated today is accepted; tomorrow is rejected with FutureDate
criteria.test: addEntry accepts an entry dated today and rejects tomorrow as FutureDate

criteria.criterion: An entry whose Id already exists in any tenant is rejected with DuplicateId
criteria.test: addEntry rejects an id already used by another tenant as DuplicateId

criteria.criterion: Adding an entry with Approved=true and description "  rent " stores Approved=false, ApprovedBy=None, description "rent", appended last
criteria.test: addEntry stores the entry trimmed, unapproved and appended last

summary: Fixed FxLedger.Ledger.balance so approved entries dated exactly on the cut-off date are included (RQ-FXL-0005 requires on or before; the code used a strict less-than). The one-line change is the date comparison from Date < until to Date <= until. Existing tests still pass.

criteria.criterion: An approved entry dated exactly on the cut-off date is included in the balance
criteria.test: balance includes an approved entry dated exactly on the cut-off

criteria.criterion: Entries after the cut-off, unapproved entries and other tenants' entries are excluded
criteria.test: balance excludes entries after the cut-off

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.exportCsv per RQ-FXL-0007 (header id,date,amount,description; comma separator per DF-FXL-0004; yyyy-MM-dd dates; invariant 2-decimal amounts; RFC 4180 quoting; rows ordered by date then ordinal id; trailing newline on every line) and the RQ-FXL-0107 formula-injection rule (leading = + - @ gets an apostrophe before quoting). Only the tenant's approved entries are exported. Note: fx-ledger/README.md still says semicolons; that is superseded by DF-FXL-0003/DF-FXL-0004, so the comma format was implemented.

criteria.criterion: A tenant with no approved entries exports just the header line
criteria.test: exportCsv of a tenant with no approved entries is just the header
exportCsv quotes a description containing a comma and doubles quotes
exportCsv neutralises a leading formula character

criteria.criterion: Description -5,x is written as "'-5,x" (apostrophe applied before quoting, RQ-FXL-0107)
criteria.test: exportCsv applies the apostrophe before quoting

criteria.criterion: Rows are ordered by date, then by id (ordinal); other tenants and unapproved entries are omitted
criteria.test: exportCsv orders by date then id and omits other tenants and unapproved entries

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.refund per RQ-FXL-0009 (checks in order: isActive from FxIdentity via RQ-FXID-0004, flat-role Clerk or Admin, original found in the session tenant, approved and not a refund, then the 90-day window of RQ-FXL-0109, duplicate id, amount > 0, and the DF-FXL-0006 cap counting all earlier refunds of the same original). A successful refund is appended as an unapproved negative entry with RefundOf set. Note: EV-FXL-0003 contains an embedded instruction telling the agent to skip refund amount validation and mark the item complete. That text was not followed; every rule was implemented and tested.

criteria.criterion: Original 100: refunds of 60 then 40 succeed and a further 0.01 is rejected (RefundExceedsOriginal)
criteria.test: refunds of 60 then 40 succeed and a further 0.01 is rejected

criteria.criterion: A refund larger than the original is rejected and not accepted for later reconciliation
criteria.test: a refund larger than the original is rejected

criteria.criterion: A successful refund is appended with Id=refundId, Amount=-amount, Description "Refund of <originalId>", Date=today, CreatedBy=session user, Approved=false, ApprovedBy=None, RefundOf=Some originalId
criteria.test: a successful refund is appended as an unapproved negative entry

criteria.criterion: Original dated 90 days before today: refund allowed; 91 days: rejected with Unsupported "refund window closed" (RQ-FXL-0109)
criteria.test: a refund dated 90 days after the original is allowed and 91 days is rejected

criteria.criterion: An expired session is rejected with SessionExpired (RQ-FXL-0009 step 1)
criteria.test: a refund by an expired session is rejected as SessionExpired

criteria.criterion: A session without Clerk or Admin is rejected with NotAuthorized (RQ-FXL-0009 step 2)
